notice: Official information and support resources. This directory does not request or dispatch emergency assistance. For immediate danger, contact the emergency services and civil-protection authority responsible for your location. Availability and eligibility are determined by each organization.

resources.name: IFRC National Societies Directory
resources.description: Find the official Red Cross or Red Crescent Society for a country and its published contact details.

resources.name: ICRC Restoring Family Links
resources.description: Official guidance and country contacts for people separated from family during conflict, disaster or migration.

resources.name: WMO World Weather Information Service
resources.description: Find participating national meteorological services and links to their official weather information.

resources.name: Copernicus Emergency Management Service
resources.description: Public emergency mapping products for preparedness, response and recovery. Only authorized users can request activations.

resources.name: UNITAR United Nations Satellite Centre
resources.description: Official satellite analysis, emergency mapping, training and capacity development resources.

resources.name: OCHA Humanitarian Coordination Resources
resources.description: Reference material about humanitarian coordination, participating agencies and coordination mechanisms.

resources.name: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction
resources.description: Disaster-risk reduction knowledge, policy, resilience and preparedness resources.

resources.name: FEMA Ready.gov
resources.description: Household and business emergency-preparedness guidance and planning resources.

resources.name: Mexico CENAPRED
resources.description: Official disaster-prevention information, educational resources and hazard-monitoring publications.

resources.name: NOAA National Weather Service
resources.description: Official forecasts, weather warnings and links to hurricane, fire-weather and other specialist services.

resources.name: USGS
resources.description: Earthquake records with origin time, location, magnitude and source updates. Preliminary earthquake information can change.

resources.name: NASA EONET
resources.description: Continuously updated, curated references to natural events and their originating information sources. Coverage is not a complete global incident register.

resources.name: GDACS
resources.description: Indicative disaster notifications and potential-impact estimates supporting humanitarian awareness. Official local and national warnings take precedence.

resources.name: MET Norway
resources.description: Point weather forecasts with model-update and valid times. A forecast describes expected conditions and is not an observed disaster event.
